mekayis.metin:
(أَكَفَ) الْهَمْزَةُ وَالْكَافُ وَالْفَاءُ لَيْسَ أَصْلًا، لِأَنَّ الْهَمْزَةَ مُبْدَلَةٌ مِنْ وَاوٍ، يُقَالُ: وِكَافٌ وَإِكَافٌ.
[بَابُ الْهَمْزَةِ وَاللَّامِ وَمَا يَثْلِثُهُمَا]

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أكف (form I)
# أَكُفُّ (ʔakuffu) /ʔa.kuf.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of كَفَّ (kaffa)
# أُكَفُّ (ʔukaffu) /ʔu.kaf.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of كَفَّ (kaffa)
# أَكُفَّ (ʔakuffa) /ʔa.kuf.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of كَفَّ (kaffa)
# أُكَفَّ (ʔukaffa) /ʔu.kaf.fa/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunct
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: أُكَّاف or أُكَاف • (ʔukkāf or ʔukāf) m (plural أُكُف (ʔukuf) or آكِفَة (ʔākifa))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Aramaic אוּכָּפָא / ܐܽܘܟܳܦܴܐ (ʾukkāp̄ā) from which also Hebrew אֻכָּף (ʾukkāp̄), from Akkadian 𒌑𒂵𒁁 (ukāpu, “saddlecloth”).
g: a saddle, a packsaddle (typically of an ass)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: إِكَاف • (ʔikāf) m (plural أُكُف (ʔukuf) or آكِفَة (ʔākifa) or أَكِفَّة (ʔakiffa))
